scope: Atomic field union extracted from the 14 PPT-listed methods only. This artifact intentionally excludes fields introduced solely by our proposed method.

requiredness.required: Every final dataset item should carry the field.
requiredness.recommended: Collect whenever the relevant channel is observable; absence must be explicit.
requiredness.conditional: Collect only when that method channel/stage is present.
requiredness.optional: Analysis, training, weak-proxy, or ground-truth-only feature.

field_contract.paper_ids_rule: Each field separates strict core experimental seeds from schema/method references.
